## Overview

Visible heading of a [`MenuGroupDirective`](/docs/reference/api/primitives/menu-group-directive) or `qzMenuRadioGroup`. It names the group via
`aria-labelledby` and is not interactive: it is never registered as a menu item, never the
roving-focus destination, and is skipped by arrow keys, Home/End and typeahead.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `qzMenuLabel`
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/menu/menu-group.directive.ts:86](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/menu/menu-group.directive.ts#L86)

## Selector

```text
[qzMenuLabel]
```
